## Project Notes

- Keep the storefront responsive and consistent with its high-contrast charcoal, forest-black, and lime visual system.
- Every game detail should include story, developer, release details, and minimum/recommended system requirements.
- Catalog entries and checkout are demo-only; do not imply real payment or inventory integration.
- Game listing data and artwork use a dated snapshot from Steam's public store endpoints; prices and news are not live.
- Typefaces load from Google Fonts.
- Verify changes with `npm run build` and `npm run lint`.
